caption: The drawing features three brooches, each made of gold-colored metal, arranged in a triangular composition against a plain, beige background. The brooch in the upper left has a looping, oval shape with a textured gold band and a cluster of small, round, red elements, possibly representing berries or gemstones, attached to a gold and silver leaf-like accent. The upper right brooch also has an oval form with crossing gold bands and features dark silver or black leaf patterns within the oval frame. The lower brooch, positioned at the bottom left, is similar in form to the upper left brooch with the addition of a long, straight pin extending from its base and a cluster of small, red elements paired with gold and silver textured shapes. The name "JOHN. H. TERCUZZI" is printed in small, black capital letters in the lower left corner of the drawing. There are also some small orange specks near the center-right area of the background.
title: Brooch
